witness_description: No concrete witness can be certified from the supplied quote.
refutation_explanation: The quote does not define the problem, "k-Matroid", the domain of k, feasible instances, or what constitutes the stated approximation guarantee. Consequently, exact parameter substitutions—including substitutions for which k-epsilon is zero—cannot by themselves certify a counterexample without inventing missing semantics.
search_space: Illustrative exact sweep: all 44 pairs (k, epsilon) with k in {1,2,3,4} and epsilon in the 11-element reduced Fraction set generated by p/q for p,q in {1,2,3,4}; every pair was visited in increasing-k, then increasing-epsilon order. This is not exhaustive for the unbounded claim.
